title: Demographically-Inspired Query Variants Using an LLM

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM to generate query variants simulating 'Child' and 'Senior' users, then evaluating whether Information Retrieval (IR) systems provide equal retrieval effectiveness (using NDCG@10) for these different age groups.

Generating query variants with an LLM to simulate 'Native' and 'Non-native' English speakers, and comparing the downstream effectiveness and performance disparities of IR systems handling these queries.
Generating query variants that reflect 'Novice' and 'Expert' user characteristics using an LLM, and measuring the resulting variance in search engine ranking performance.
Simulating query variations based on user search modality preferences ('Mobile' vs. 'Voice' search) to test if IR systems serve users with different technological interaction styles equally.
